blocks.text: Hum dekh chuke hain ke linear momentum ajsam ki muntaqili harkat mein aham kirdar ada karta hai; isi tarah angular momentum naami ek aur miqdar gardishi harkat ke mutaale mein aham kirdar rakhti hai.

blocks.title: Angular momentum
blocks.text: Zarra kisi reference axis ke gird angular momentum rakhta kaha jata hai agar woh yun chale ke us ki zawiyai jagah us reference axis ki nisbat badle. Velocity v aur momentum p se chalte mass m ke zarre ka asal O ki nisbat angular momentum L (Fig. 3.16, jaisa chhapa) L = r x p ... (3.20) se bayan hota hai, jahan r us lamhe O ki nisbat zarre ka position vector hai. Angular momentum vector quantity hai; us ki miqdar L = r p sin theta = m r v sin theta hai, jahan theta r aur p ke darmiyan zawiya hai. L ki simt r aur p ki bani satah par amood hai, aur us ka rukh vector product ke right-hand rule se milta hai. Angular momentum ka SI unit kg m^2 s^-1 ya J s hai.

Agar zarra radius r ke daire mein yaksan angular velocity omega se chale to r aur tangential velocity ke darmiyan zawiya 90 degrees hai; is liye L = m r v sin 90 = m r v, aur chunke v = r omega, L = m r^2 omega. Ab apne centre of mass se guzarte fixed axis ke gird ghoomta symmetric sakht jism lein (Fig. 3.17). Jism ka har zarra usi axis ke gird daire mein angular velocity omega se ghoomta hai. Mass m_i ke zarre ke angular momentum ki miqdar asal O ke gird m_i v_i r_i hai, aur L_i ki simt omega jaisi. Chunke v_i = r_i omega, i-wein zarre ka angular momentum m_i r_i^2 omega hai; sab zarron par majmooa sakht jism ka kul angular momentum deta hai, L = (m_i r_i^2 ka majmooa) omega = I omega, jahan I gardish ke axis ke gird sakht jism ka moment of inertia hai. Sunehri teer ke rukh ghoomte sphere ki angular velocity aur angular momentum gardishi axis ke saath oopar li jati hain, jaisa right-hand rule dikhata hai (For Your Information).

blocks.title: Example 3.5
blocks.text: Zameen ka mass 6.00 x 10^24 kg hai aur Zameen se Suraj ka faasla r 1.50 x 10^11 m. North Star ki simt se dekhne par Zameen Suraj ke gird counter-clockwise ghoomti hai. Suraj ke gird Zameen ka madari angular momentum nikalein, yeh maan kar ke woh saal mein ek bar (3.16 x 10^7 s) Suraj ke gird dairawi madar tay karti hai. Hal: madari angular momentum ke liye pehle madari speed chahiye. Radius r ke daire par chalte hue Zameen ek saal mein faasla 2 pi r tay karti hai, to us ki madari speed v_o = 2 pi r / t. Zameen ka madari angular momentum = L_o = m v_o r = 2 pi r^2 m / t = 2 pi (1.50 x 10^11 m)^2 (6.00 x 10^24 kg) / (3.16 x 10^7 s) = 2.67 x 10^40 kg m^2 s^-1. Nishan musbat hai kyunke gardish counter-clockwise hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: O par pivoted chhari par mass amood force F ke saath, torque aur moment-of-inertia equations, aur chhari, hoop, disc aur sphere ke formulas. Oopar darmiyan: O se position r par momentum p wala zarra zawiya theta aur zarre, daire aur sakht jism ke angular momentum formulas ke saath. Oopar daen: baqa ka qanoon diver, skater aur turntable ki misalon ke saath. Neeche: flywheel, gyroscope, Example 3.5 aur side notes.
blocks.caption: Moment of inertia, angular momentum aur us ka baqa (Figures 3.15 se 3.23 aur topics 3.4 se 3.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Chhari par amood force us ke sire ke mass ko tangential acceleration deti hai, aur radius se zarb dene par qanoon-e-harkat torque barabar mass zarb radius ka muraba zarb angular acceleration ban jata hai, to mass zarb axis se faasle ka muraba mass ka kirdar ada karta hai; sakht jism ke liye us ke sab tukron par in ka majmooa moment of inertia hai, jo mass axis se door hone par sab se bara hai. Zarre ka angular momentum us ke position vector aur momentum ka vector product hai, right-hand rule se un ki satah par amood, dairawi harkat ke liye mass zarb radius zarb speed aur sakht jism ke liye moment of inertia zarb angular velocity ke barabar. Bahri torque na ho to system ka kul angular momentum mustaqil hai, to jab diver ya skater hath paon samete to moment of inertia ghatta aur gardish tez hoti hai, flywheel gardishi energy mehfooz karta aur machinein hamwar rakhta hai, aur tez ghoomta gyroscope khala mein apna axis qaim rakhta aur hawai jahazon, aabdozon aur spacecraft ki rehnumai karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Cycle ke pahiye ka angular momentum 10 kg m^2 s^-1 aur angular velocity 2 rad s^-1 hai; us ka moment of inertia nikalein (numerical problem 3.9). Dikhayein ke madari harkat ke liye L = I omega (comprehensive question 3.2).
blocks.explanation: I = L / omega = 10 / 2 = 5 kg m^2. Daire mein zarre ke liye L = m r v, v = r omega ke saath, to L = m r^2 omega; chunke axis ke gird nuqtai mass ka moment of inertia I = m r^2 hai, L = I omega, sakht jism jaisi shakal.

items: L = r x p; miqdar r p sin theta = m r v sin theta; simt right-hand rule se r aur p par amood; unit kg m^2 s^-1 = J s.
Daira: L = m r v = m r^2 omega. Sakht jism: L = I omega axis ke saath. Example 3.5: Zameen ka madari angular momentum 2.67 x 10^40 kg m^2 s^-1, musbat (counter-clockwise).
